text:
noor (Design): Heads-up: prototype for a 'Mapping preview' in the invite modal. Idea: when SSO is on, show a small collapsible row "Preview role mapping" that expands to show how the email domain maps to a role. Helps reduce support asks. Mock: https://redwood.app/s/mapping-preview :sparkles:
ben (PM): saw this concept in customer interviews — they want confidence before sending invites. Two concerns: 1) accuracy (IdP mappings can be complex), 2) privacy/leakage of IdP attributes.
cody (FE): implementation note: we can call the mapping-preview endpoint which returns a best-effort mapping sample (no PII) for the current org. We should sanitize so we never return user emails, only domain-level rules or example placeholders like "*@acme.com -> Member".
arya (A11y): accessibility: collapsible needs proper aria-expanded on the chevron and focusable children. If we render example rows, make them list items with role="list"/"listitem" and avoid relying purely on color to convey status.
noor (Design): copy suggestions: collapsed label: "Preview role mapping"; expanded heading: "How your IdP assigns roles"; sample line: "Emails matching *@acme.com receive: Member" (muted, monospace). Link: "Learn about provisioning". Keep the preview read-only.
ben (PM): on privacy: ops team flagged that mapping endpoints are logged by proxies. Make sure response is scrubbed and add a header to disable logging in our internal proxy if possible. Also, warn in UI: "This preview shows rules, not user data."
cody (FE): will add a request header and call the endpoint only for users with manage-org permission. Also throttle the preview fetch to avoid hammering IdP integrations. For now we'll fallback to "Mapping preview unavailable" if the endpoint errors.
arya (A11y): keyboard flow: tab into the chevron, Enter expands, focus lands on the first sample row, Esc collapses back to chevron. Also ensure screen reader announces the mapping count (e.g., "3 mapping rules shown").
noor (Design): small UX nit: if mapping preview is long, make the panel scrollable with max-height 220px and show a gradient fade. That way the invite modal doesn't blow up. Also show a tiny CTA: "Open mapping settings" which deep-links to admin provisioning page. Copy: 'Manage provisioning rules'.
ben (PM): acceptance criteria: - collapsible preview present when SSO enabled; - no PII returned; - aria attributes implemented; - deep link to provisioning settings; - backend adds scrub header. Target: ship in 1.28 as an opt-in feature flag. Quick fix: change disabled select copy to "Roles managed by SSO" and add info link (hotfix).
cody (FE): putting together PR for hotfix now, will include a11y attrs. Will open a separate branch for mapping-preview feature flag.
ops-bot: preview build deployed to staging at 2026-03-26T08:45Z (branch feat/mapping-preview-hotfix) :rocket:
noor (Design): thanks team. I'll add the final copy and microcopy rules to the ticket and tag docs for the provisioning guide link.
ben (PM): assign QA to run keyboard-only test and a privacy review before enabling the flag. :white_check_mark:
